allot.subject: Acquisition
allot.text: Intimation of Investment in Sudha Somany Ceramics Private Limited, a Subsidiary of the Company, by way of rights issue on 10th June 2026.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: The Company has further acquired 30,00,000/- (Thirty Lakhs) equity shares of Rs. 10/- each aggregating to Rs. 3,00,00,000/- (Rupees Three Crores Only) in M/s Sudha Somany Ceramics Private Limited, a Subsidiary of the Company, by way of rights issue on 28th October, 2025.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: In furtherance to our earlier intimation dated 13th August, 2025, we would like to inform that the Company has invested Rs. 30,00,00,000 (Rupees Thirty Crores Only) in M/s Somany Max Private Limited, Subsidiary of the Company, towards the acquisition of equity shares by way of rights issue.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( Listing Regulations ), we hereby inform that the Company has allotted 3,201 equity shares of face value of Rs. 2/- each on 13th August, 2025 pursuant to exercise of Employee Stock Options under the ESOP Plan 2023 as per the applicable regulations.
